piece: The tall 9:16 cut (mon02-tall) of Mon 2 Nov follow.the.money "Who trains your 2030 seniors". Title: "Claude's AI is eating the jobs of its own humans". Thumbnail: "CLAUDE IS EATING ITS OWN JOBS". Motion system: The Ladder.
source_file: 3 Posts/2026-11-02 Mon follow.the.money - Who trains your 2030 seniors/3 Video/Who trains your 2030 seniors - tall 9x16 - Shorts, Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn.mp4 (1080x1920, 30 fps, 68.47 s)
idea: One object, a career ladder, carries the whole piece. Every number is counted onto, beside or in place of a part of it. It sits either on a vignetted ink desk or in a butter tray over his chest. Every scene that steps away ends by turning back into the ladder, now changed: the gap where the junior rung was.
motion_grammar:
All timings at 30 fps.

- **Tray entrance:** the butter tray over the face fades in over f0-1 to about 40% opacity, at about 0.6 scale, anchored bottom-left. Over f2-7 it rises and scales to 1.0 on the enter curve. It settles at f7 with about 2% overshoot, top edge at y 1094. The ladder then draws inside the tray: the rails go left to right over 6 f, then the rungs pop in left to right, one every 3 f.
- **Title card:** the butter title card drops from about 60 px above, fading in over f0-2. It rotates from -4 deg to a resting -2 deg and is settled by f4-5. The ink FOLLOW.THE.MONEY tag comes with it.
- **Mint answer cards:** they drop into the tray tilted about -8 deg, from slightly right and below. They land in 6-8 f and keep a resting tilt: left card -2 deg, right card +3 deg. Each card arrives on its own word, not on a fixed stagger.
- **Count:** the hero number rolls on the enter curve.
  - 0 to 27% takes 27 f, with the big steps first (0, 8, 13, 18, 21, 24, 25, 26, 27 at 10 fps).
  - +6 to +43% takes about 15 f.
  - A count-down leaves the previous value as a ghost to the right, at about 25% opacity and about 40% of the size.
- **Quote reveal:** the pull quote's words go from inkSoft grey to cream one at a time, on the spoken word. Then a butter highlight sweeps behind the proving phrase word by word, about 3 f a word, with ink type on butter.
- **Page:** the source page drops in at top right, tilted +3 deg, in about 6 f, then pushes slowly to about 1.04.
- **Units:**
  - On the tile field, lost tiles fade to inkSoft about 2 f apart.
  - The BANK block copies itself in from the right every 3-4 f while the group slides left.
  - The bars stack upward one at a time.
- **Changes:** every change is a 10 f (0.35 s) crossfade on the word that names the new picture, panel to face and face to panel alike.
- **Exits:** trays and cards fade out over 9-10 f. They never slide out.
- **Drift:** objects drift about 1.5% of their size; nothing fully stops.
- **Gaps:** the longest gap between visual events is 3.4 s; the median is 0.2 s.

profile_proposal.note: eating-its-jobs (mon02-tall): one through-line object; numbers roll onto it on the enter curve; a butter tray rises and scales in from bottom-left over the face to hold the object or the mint answer cards; pull quotes reveal word by word, then take a butter highlight; every change is a 10-frame crossfade on its word; nothing holds still.

gaps: The ladder is still in needs_device. ve has no through-line object that keeps its state across beats: draw the rails, pop the rungs, thin a rung, swap a rung for a dashed gap, light the top rung.
There is no butter tray container that rises and scales in from bottom-left over the face with a hard ink drop.
Cards cannot keep a resting tilt, and there is no 'drop in with rotation' entrance kind (the title card and the mint cards need it).
A count-down cannot leave a ghost of the previous value.
There is no pull-quote reveal (grey to cream by word) followed by a highlight sweep by word.
There is no field of unit marks that loses, greys or copies units, and no isometric block object that copies itself.
The 'dark' ground has no radial vignette from ink to inkSoft.
The ingredients transition list has no crossfade value, so the profile's own transition has to carry it. The measured 10 frames is the top of the allowed 6-10 range.
ve study failed on this machine: PyAV's open() rejected the metadata_errors keyword, so grammar.json was not written. Cuts per minute (about 20) was counted by eye from the strips.
camera: The camera does not move on the face beats; it is his handheld take, steadied. On graphics beats there is a slow push to about 1.03-1.04 across the beat, plus object drift. No zoom-to-focus and no whips.
captions_seen: The cut has the burned-in house captions, which are not part of this style. They are cream Archivo Black on an ink block with a hard butter drop and underline. The phrase builds word by word at about y 1450-1525. The closest caption theme in the bank is grape (an ink card with words arriving), but any theme can be paired with this style.
devices_used: Butter tray over the face holding the ladder or the cards
Ladder: rails, rungs, a dashed missing rung, a 2030 top label
Hero number count, with a ghost of the previous value on a count-down
Tile field of people, lost tiles greyed out
Source page with a tilt and a slow push
Pull quote revealed word by word, then a butter highlight sweep
Spreadsheet with a cursor and one cell filling mint
Mint question cards and numeral cards in the tray
Butter title card that drops in
ground: Graphics beats sit on an ink desk with a radial vignette, measured #101A17 at the edges lifting to #16221D (inkSoft) in the centre. Face beats are his take, with the butter tray laid over it.
palette_use:
- **Ink:** the ground, with a radial vignette lifting to inkSoft in the centre.
- **Cream:** the objects, numbers and quote type.
- **Series colour** (follow.the.money butter, measured #FBD54E): the tray, the title card, the series pill, the highlight behind the proving phrase, and the marks on junior tiles.
- **Mint:** only the answer. That is the 2030 label, the question and action cards, and the one filled spreadsheet cell.
- **inkSoft grey:** lost units and the missing rung.
- **Nothing else** is coloured.
sound: The licensed bed (No Curves) runs under the whole cut at about -14 LUFS. The motion system allows one sound, on the drop; no other hits were measured.
transitions: Every picture change is a 10-frame (0.35 s) crossfade on the word that names it, between panels and between face and panel alike. There is one cut, into the end card after his last word.
type_treatment:
- **Anton:** hero numbers, the title card and card labels, all in caps.
- **Archivo Black:** pull quotes and legends, in mixed case.
- **IBM Plex Mono:** credits and the series tag, in caps.
- **Fraunces:** not used.
never: No figures or icons acting out a sentence; the object only ever shows a number or the gap.
No on-screen words that repeat what he says; a card adds the number, the producer, the date or the changed word.
No eyebrow labels, kickers, asterisks or AI notes.
The series colour is never a warning and never marks the answer; mint marks nothing but the answer.
No slide or whip exits, and no hard cut between panels except into the end card.
No graphic held still for more than 3.5 s.
Do not crowd the tray under the platform buttons (F30: on Instagram he said "It looks cramped").
studied: 2026-11-13, by a separate reader per cut (ve pace on the whole frame, dense strips at speed); captions burned into the cut count in events_per_s
